final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS r FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s1) SELECT s1.name, s1.r, s1.r - s2.a FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.r > s2.a
